backTranslation: Each other creature you control that is enchanted by an Aura you control has base power and toughness 5/4 and has flying.

name: Bramble Wurm
lines: {2}{G}, Exile this card from your graveyard: You gain 5 life.

name: Goblin Chainwhirler
lines: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.
backTranslation: When this enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent and 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker your opponents control.

name: Guardian of Faith
lines: When this creature enters, any number of other target creatures you control phase out.
backTranslation: When this enters, choose any number of other target creatures you control. Phase out each of them.

name: Hard-Hitting Question
lines: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.

name: Horrific Assault
lines: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control. If you control an Eldrazi, you gain 3 life.
backTranslation: Choose a target creature you control and a target permanent. The creature you control deals damage equal to its power to that permanent. Then if you control a permanent with the subtype Eldrazi, you gain 3 life.

name: Might of Old Krosa
lines: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you cast this spell during your main phase, that creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn instead.
backTranslation:
Target creature.
This spell does nothing.

name: Pulse of Murasa
lines: Return target creature or land card from a graveyard to its owner's hand. You gain 6 life.

name: The Fifth Doctor
lines: Peaceful Coexistence — At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that didn't attack or enter this turn. Untap those creatures.
backTranslation: At the beginning of your end step, you may do the following. Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that didn't attack this turn and didn't enter the battlefield this turn. Untap each creature you control that didn't attack this turn and didn't enter the battlefield this turn.

name: Thundering Raiju
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then this creature deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of modified creatures you control other than this creature.
